book.name: SOHN
book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn SOHN

content: Sises oh Rie Ohl akan
Mwurin mepwukat, Sises ketin seiseiloakseli nan Kalili; e sohte kupwurki seiloak nan Sudia, pwehki mehn Suhs ako me mi wasao ar kin men kemehla.
Eri, sarawi lapalap ehu en mehn Suhs ako, me adaneki Sarawien Impwal, kerendohr.
Rie ohl ako eri patohwanohng, “Kohkohweisang met, oh kohwei Sudia, pwe noumw tohnpadahk kan en kilang doadoahk kan me ke kin wiewia.
Pwehki sohte mehmen kin ekihla dahme e kin wiewia, ma e anahne ndand. Eri, pwehki omw wiewia mepwukat, mweidohng sampah pwon en ese duwe!”
(Pwe rie ohl ako sohte pwoson Sises.)
Sises ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Ahnsou me konehng ie saikinte leledo. Ahpw kumwail sohte lipilipil ahnsou da me mwahuwong kumwail.
Sampah sohte kak kailongkin kumwail, a e kin kailongkin ie, pwehki ei kin kalap padahkihong me eh wiewia kan me suwed.
Kumwail kohdahla iang sarawio, pwe I sohte pahn kohdahla iang sarawi wet, pwehki ei ahnsou saikinte leledo.”
E ketin mahsanihong irail mepwukat, e ahpw ketikette nan Kalili.
Sises ketin Iang Sarawien Impwal
Mwurin rie ohl ako ar mwesellahngehr sarawio, Sises ahpw pil ketiketla. E sohte ketidahla ni sansal, ahpw e ketidahla ni rir.
Kaunen mehn Suhs ako ahpw raparapahki Sises nan sarawio. Re ahpw idek, “Ia ih?”
Aramas ako ahpw mwengininginkiseli nan pokono duwen ih. Ekei aramas kin nda, “Ohl mwahu men ih.” A ekei kin nda, “Soh! E kin pitih aramas.”
Ahpw sohte me koasoia ni sansal duwen Sises, pwehki arail masak kaunen mehn Suhs ako.
Ni eh lel nan lukopen wihk en sarawio, iei ahnsou me Sises ketidalahng ni Tehnpas Sarawio oh tapihada padahk.
Kaunen mehn Suhs ako inenen pwuriamweikihla oh nda, “Ia duwen ohl menet eh nohn wehwehki soahng kan nan eh sohte iang sukuhl?”
Sises eri ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Kaidehn pein ei padahk me I kin kihda, ahpw sapwellimen Koht me ketin kadariehdo.
Mehmen me anahne kapwaiada kupwur en Koht, iei ih me pahn wehwehki duwen ei padahk kan, ma sang rehn Koht de sang pein ei manaman.
Aramas emen me koasoakoasoia duwen pein ih kin songosong en ale wauwi. A mehmen me anahne wauneki me kadarodo ih, iei ih me mehlel oh pil sohte likamw kis mi reh.
Kaidehn Moses me kihong kumwail Kosonnedo? A sohte emen nanpwungamwail me kin kapwaiada Kosonnedo. Dahme kahrehda kumwail kin raparapahkihki en kemeiehla?”
Tohn pokono ahpw patohwanohng, “Ngehn suwed mie rehmwi! Ihs me raparapahki en kemeikomwihla?”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Doadoahk manaman teieu me I wiadahr, a kumwail koaros pwuriamweikihla.

Pwehki Moses eh koasoanediong kumwail en sirkumsaisihala noumwail seri kan (ahpw kaidehn sang rehn Moses, a samamwail ko me tapihada tiahk wet,) kumwail eri kin sirkumsaisihala emen pwutak ni rahnen Sapad.
Eri, ma pwutak emen pahn sirkumsaisla ni rahnen Sapad, pwe Kosonned en Moses dehr ohla, a dahme kahrehda kumwail lingeringerki pahi pwehki ei kakehladahr douluhl ohlo ni rahnen Sapad?
Amwail kadeik en dehr wiawi ni pali liki, ahpw en poasoankihda dahme uhdahn mehlel.”
Kaidehn Ih Mesaiao?
Ekei aramas en Serusalem nda, “Kaidehn ih ohl menet me irail raparapahki pwe re en kemehla?
A kilang! E kin padapadahk ni sansal, sohte mwahn emen me nda mehkot pwe en pelian! Ia duwe, kaun akan uhdahn wehwehkidahr me iei ih Mesaiao?
Ahpw ni ahnsou me Mesaia pahn ketido, sohte emen pahn dehdehki ia wasa me e ketidohsang ie. A kitail koaros wehwehki wasa me ohl menet kohdohsang sang ie.”

Eri, ni en Sises eh padapadahk nan Tehnpas Sarawio, e ahpw kapitie laudida, mahsanih, “Ia duwe, kumwail uhdahn ese ie, oh pil ese wasa me I kohsang ie? I sohte kohkihdo pein ei manaman. A ih me ketin kadariehdo, iei ih me mehlel, ahpw kumwail sehse ih.
A I ese, pwe I kohdohsang reh, oh ih me ketin kadariehdo.”
Irail eri song re en koledi Sises, ahpw sohte emen me sair, pwehki sapwellime ahnsou saikinte leledo.
A me tohto nanpwungen pokono me pwosonla, oh nda, “Ia duwe, ni ahnsou me Mesaia ketido, e pahn ketin wiahda kilel tohtohsang me ohl menet wiadahr?”
Silepe kei Pekederlahr pwe re en Koledi Sises
Eri, Parisi ko rongadahr duwen soahng pwukat me pokono mwengimwengininginki duwe, irail oh samworo lapalap ako ahpw kadarala ekei pilismen pwe re en koledi Sises.
Sises ahpw ketin mahsanih, “I pahn mihmi rehmwail ahnsou kis; eri, mwuhr, I pahn pwuralahng rehn ih me ketin kadariehdo.
Kumwail pahn rapahkin ie, ahpw kumwail sohte pahn diar ie; pwe wasa me I pahn mi ie, kumwail sohte kak kohla ie.”

Kaunen mehn Suhs ako ahpw ndindapene nanpwungarail, “Ia wasa me e pahn kohla ie, me kitail sohte kak diarki? Ia duwe, e pahn kolahng nan kahnimw en mehn Krihs kan, wasa me mehn Suhs kei koukousoan ie, oh padahk ong mehn Krihs kan?
E kin koasoia, ‘Kumwail pahn rapahkin ie, ahpw kumwail sohte pahn diar ie;’ oh, ‘Kumwail sohte kak kolahng wasa me I pahn mi ie.’ Ia wehwehn met?”
Pilen Komour
Rahn me sarawio imwisekla me keieu kesempwal. Ni rahno Sises ahpw ketida oh kapitie laudida, mahsanih, “Mehmen me men nimpildahr en kohdo rehi oh nimpil.
Nin duwen me Pwuhk Sarawi mahsanih, ‘Mehmen me pwoson ie, pilen komour pahn pwilweisang nan eh mohngiong.’”
Sises ketin mahsanih met duwen Ngehno me irail akan me pwoson ih pahn ahneki. Pwe ni ahnsowo, Ngehno saikinte pwarodo, pwehki Sises saikinte linganla.
Aramas akan Liaktohrohrpeseng
Me tohto nanpwungen pokono, ni arail rongada Sises ni eh mahsanih met, re ahpw nda, “Mehlel, ohl menet, iei ih Soukohpo!”
Pil ekei nda, “Iei ih Mesaiao!” A ekei pil nda, “Mesaiao sohte pahn ketido sang Kalili!
Pwe Pwuhk Sarawi mahsanih me Mesaiao pahn ketido sang ni kadaudok en Depit, oh e pahn ipwidi nan Pedleem, nan kahnimw me Depit kousoan ie.”
Pokono eri liaktohrohrpeseng nanpwungarail pwehki Sises.
A ekei anahne re en koledi, ahpw sohte emen me sair.
Seupwoson en Kaunen mehn Suhs ko
Eri, pilismen ko pwuralahng rehn samworo lapalap ako oh Parisi ko. Irail ahpw idek rehrail, “Dahme kahrehda kumwail sohte wahkihdo ohlo?”
Pilismen ko ahpw sapeng, “Sohte mehmen me kin padahk duwehte ohlo!”
Parisi ko eri idek rehrail, “Ia duwe, ohlo pil pitihkumwaildier?
Kumwail ese me mie emen sang nanpwungen me lapalap akan de Parisi kan me pwosonlahr ih?
Pokon wet sohte wehwehki duwen Kosonned en Moses, ihme kahrehda re riahkilahr!”
Eri, Nikodihmus, emen kisehrail, me kolahng rehn Sises mahso, e ahpw ndaiong irail,
“Nin duwen atail Kosonned, kitail sohte kak kadeikada aramas emen mwohn atail saikinte karonge mahs oh diarada dahme e wiahda.”
Irail ahpw sapeng, “Ia duwe, komwi pil emen mehn Kalili? Ma komwi pahn tehk nan Pwuhk Sarawi, komwi pahn ese me sohte soukohp men kak kohda sang nan Kalili.”
